info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Customer Management Customer Behavior Insight-spec
info.description: The Customer Behavior Insights API enables businesses to gain valuable insights into customer behavior within banking services. By analyzing data on customer interactions and preferences, this API empowers organizations to enhance their customer management strategies. Typical users include marketing teams and customer service departments looking to optimize engagement and personalize offers. This endpoint facilitates the submission of new customer behavior data to improve analysis and insights generation.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to submit data pertaining to customer behavior insights. It processes the provided information to generate valuable insights that can assist in decision-making and enhancing customer experience.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send customer behavior insights data to the customer management system. It should contain detailed information on customer interactions and behaviors, which can be used for analytics and improving customer relationships.

201.description: New customer behavior insights successfully created.
